title: struthiopteris pendula
intro: Struthiopteris pendula, commonly known as the hanging strap fern, is a species of fern native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Struthiopteris pendula are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
